import { Schema } from "effect"

export const CsvExportOptions = Schema.Struct({
  format: Schema.Literal("csv"),
  delimiter: Schema.String,
  includeHeader: Schema.Boolean,
  filename: Schema.String
})

export const JsonExportOptions = Schema.Struct({
  format: Schema.Literal("json"),
  pretty: Schema.Boolean,
  filename: Schema.String,
  delimiter: Schema.Never.pipe(Schema.optionalKey),
  includeHeader: Schema.Never.pipe(Schema.optionalKey)
})

export const ExportOptions = Schema.Union([
  CsvExportOptions,
  JsonExportOptions
])

export type ExportOptions = typeof ExportOptions.Type

export const decodeExportOptions = Schema.decodeUnknownSync(ExportOptions)

export const defaultExportOptions: ExportOptions = {
  format: "json",
  pretty: false,
  filename: "report.json"
}

export const extensionFor = (options: ExportOptions): string =>
  options.format === "csv" ? ".csv" : ".json"
